title: bool karmoomih ankacsime wayte xongolo
intro: kaxxa magaalol uguttaamak naharal mango waktih addat, nummak yewqeh yan marih fanat dubuk yan rooci ugutte. ken giddiliino dubuk sabrit ramaddos ta dubuk yan seeco abe, miyyay horal xaaqime fidga wee kal. inkih tan maabitina ayti maleelah radde wak, tumbulleh ane wayta cisab ardi isih weeloyseh. asaaku, woo aydaadih xongoloola uxih kulli kiryaati addat tan. Atu tama diggale rooci baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu dirab sanamitte qibaadah yan marih fanat yenbeeh, ken dariifal tan astooti hangi kah yaceenim, uxih ken hangisso sinnak ken ugusuh doorimeh suge.
Anu inni ummattah qagaaqagitak seeco abeh, takkay immay oson ken innah tan num kinniyom yoo malkisen, yi farmo anqasak, aytiita alfeenih.
Bar kee loqo, anu ken essereeh, qilmi kee qaxmeqe kassiisitte, takkay immay yi qangor hawal baytam celta, obbe wayteeh, obbe wayte.
Yallih amrih gubat, Anu kafin ardil coox kee luucih fidin merraytu xiseeh, yi ummatta sabab wee numih gurral yoo asaaluk sugte.
Kaxxa weeqi xagana elle cule innal yemeete waqdi, yi baxi yoo luk sugeh yan doonik fanah gexam cineh, qale kaa culselem yaamineh.
Anu ardi bagul qusba qimmoh patriarch akkem kee yi xaagi Qur’aanak yi migaq luk sugeh yan mafdagal daffeyteh tan.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
verse: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day. (71:5)
